evals.prompt: 我上传了一张柠檬水瓶和冰咖啡杯的照片，帮我用喜茶那种风格分别做带字版和不带字版。带字版要有歪歪扭扭的儿童字，没字版不要出现任何文字。
evals.expected_output: A two-template response that treats the typography-led version and no-text narrative version as separate concepts, not the same layout with text toggled.
expectations: The output offers or uses the three template choices: 带字版, 无字版, 两套都出（推荐）.
If private-assets/reference-cutouts/asset-index.json exists, the output lists separate selected reference assets for each template.
The 带字版 prompt makes rough crooked childlike Chinese marker lettering the first visual priority.
The 带字版 selects or describes a primary lettering/title-blocks/* cutout as the title rhythm reference.
The 带字版 uses or recommends lettering/glyphs/* and lettering/strokes/* references when the title must be more faithful.
The 带字版 uses or recommends separate poster-base, title construction reference sheet, and title-layer prompts for publishable output instead of only one all-in-one prompt.
The 无字版 prompt forbids all invented text, letters, numbers, captions, labels, and glyphs.
The 无字版 selects or describes a primary figures/full-poses/* cutout and optionally a figures/action-parts/* cutout, and does not select any lettering/* cutout.
The two versions use different composition priorities instead of sharing one layout.
Both versions preserve the real cup and bottle as photographic objects.
Both versions use primitive black-line micro workers rather than cute cartoon characters.

evals.prompt: 这张甜品照片做一版带字的，重点还原参考里那种左上角粗黑、歪扭、小孩写坏了的中文标题。小人可以有，但不要抢标题。
evals.expected_output: A typography-led poster direction where the rough crooked title dominates the composition and the dessert plus micro worker support the title.
expectations: The output selects or clearly follows the 带字版 template.
If reference cutouts are available, the output uses or lists a primary lettering/title-blocks/* reference for title rhythm.
If the user emphasizes font fidelity, the output creates or recommends a title construction reference sheet before the title layer.
The title is described as large, rough, crooked, childlike, heavy black Chinese marker lettering.
The title treatment rejects perfect 2x2 grid placement and asks for loose staggered vertical columns when the title has four characters.
The real object is placed smaller or lower so it supports the title.
The micro worker action is restrained and does not compete with the lettering.
The prompt rejects clean fonts, rounded cute handwriting, neat calligraphy, and sans-serif text.

evals.prompt: 我想要无字版，照片是一杯茶和茶包。不要留标题空位，不要任何字，只靠小人动作和附带元素讲故事。
evals.expected_output: A no-text narrative poster direction with no title block, no invented text, and an action-led micro-worker scene around the tea object.
expectations: The output selects or clearly follows the 无字版 template.
If reference cutouts are available, the output uses or lists a primary figures/full-poses/* reference that matches the action.
The output does not use or list lettering references for the 无字版.
The prompt explicitly forbids all text, letters, numbers, labels, captions, and random glyphs.
The composition does not reserve a title area.
The micro worker action is more explicit and narrative than in the typography-led template.
Supporting elements are limited to action-serving marks such as a liquid arc, drops, ladder, bucket, bag, arrow, thought bubble, or ground line.

evals.prompt: 我这张生活物件照片背景很乱，想做成喜茶感白底海报。你先告诉我应该用带字版还是无字版，或者两套都出。
evals.expected_output: A workflow that first frames the template choice, defaults to two independent concepts if the user wants immediate output, and explains how each template would handle the same object differently.
expectations: The output explains the template choice before generation.
If reference cutouts are available, the output explains that 带字版 and 无字版 need different reference asset sets.
The default recommendation is 两套都出（推荐） when the user has not chosen.
The 带字版 concept uses typography-led composition.
The 无字版 concept uses action-led composition with no title area.
The output first isolates one primary real object from the busy background.

evals.prompt: 字体还是太像普通电脑字了。你不要重新跑整张图，重点想办法还原那种歪歪扭扭的小孩写坏了的中文标题。
evals.expected_output: A correction workflow that keeps the poster base, builds or uses a title construction reference sheet, and regenerates only the title layer.
expectations: The output does not recommend retrying the full poster as the main fix.
The output identifies the failure as a glyph-skeleton problem, not only a texture or prompt-adjective problem.
The output uses or recommends lettering/title-blocks/* for title rhythm.
The output uses or recommends lettering/glyphs/* and lettering/strokes/* for malformed glyph anatomy.
The output builds or references a title construction reference sheet before regenerating the title layer.
The output says to keep the existing poster base unchanged and iterate only the title layer.
The revision prompt rejects clean font skeletons, neat grids, calligraphy rhythm, rounded handwriting, and standard sans-serif typography.

evals.prompt: 准备把这个 skill push 上去之前，帮我检查公开包里有没有不该带的本地素材、路径或旧脚本。
evals.expected_output: A release-boundary review that intentionally ships indexed reference-study assets while excluding caches, local paths, duplicate builds, and stale generated output.
expectations: The output checks for local absolute workstation paths and private cached source references in public files.
The output confirms private-assets/reference-cutouts/ is included because the indexed style references are intended to ship.
The output verifies every indexed reference path exists and every core desktop-pet board is readable.
The output verifies README image paths resolve under assets/examples/ and do not point to outputs/ or 素材/.
The output flags raw source caches and scripts/extract_reference_assets.py as private-only if they appear in the public package.
The output verifies that scripts/build_title_reference_sheet.py and scripts/composite_title_layer.py are present when public docs mention them.
The output warns against staging .DS_Store, stale generated packages, or unrelated generated-skills output.
The output treats package cleanliness as a release gate, not as a visual-style preference.

evals.prompt: 我上传了一张只拍到桌面反光、看不清任何东西的照片，帮我做成喜茶风桌宠。
evals.expected_output: A no-subject gate that stops before generation and asks for a clearer input image with practical capture advice.
expectations: The output does not invent or guess a pet subject.
The output asks for a new photo with one clear, well-lit, sharply focused subject and a readable outline.
The output does not generate candidate art, motion prompts, or a pet pack.

evals.prompt: 照片里有一杯柠檬茶、一块蛋糕和一串钥匙，把它做成桌宠。
evals.expected_output: A multi-subject gate that identifies the independent objects and asks the user to select one before any character generation.
expectations: The output provides numbered choices for the lemon tea, cake, and keys.
The output does not silently select the clearest or most food-like item.
The output waits for subject selection before generating three candidates.

evals.prompt: 这是一杯装在透明玻璃杯里的气泡水。把水做成桌宠，直接帮我出动作。
evals.expected_output: A desktop-pet character stage that treats the glass and sparkling water as one subject and requires character approval before motion generation.
expectations: The output treats container and contents as one character by default.
The output extracts the silhouette, one to three colors, must-preserve features, and a sparkling signature-motion idea.
The output creates or proposes three same-character candidates on white or warm white.
The output does not comply with the request to skip character approval.

evals.prompt: 我选第二款，就用它。现在做桌宠动作。
evals.expected_output: A twelve-state motion-production response that uses the approved candidate as the sole identity reference, checks small-size stability, and stops for motion approval before packaging.
expectations: The output generates or specifies idle, walk, rest, happy, drag, land, wave, and signature.
The output preserves the selected silhouette, palette, face, limb proportions, line quality, and foot anchor.
The output prepares a labeled contact sheet and looping motion preview.
The output requests explicit motion approval and does not package the result yet.

evals.prompt: 动作预览确认了，帮我打成可以导入运行器的包。
evals.expected_output: A transparent schema-v2 desktop-pet pack built and independently validated after explicit motion approval.
expectations: The output exports transparent horizontal strips for all twelve actions.
The manifest contains schemaVersion, id, displayName, canvas, anchor, scale, palette, hitbox, and all action records.
The build script creates contact-sheet.png, motion-preview.gif, and a ZIP with one top-level directory.
The validation script is run against the resulting ZIP.
The output reports real artifacts and results rather than fabricating paths or validation.

evals.prompt: 这只桌宠走路时脸变了，落地动作还多出了一只手，其他动作都不错。
evals.expected_output: A focused identity-drift correction that regenerates only the failed walk and land states.
expectations: The output identifies identity drift in face and limb count.
The output keeps the approved character and six successful actions unchanged.
The correction prompt locks silhouette, palette, face placement, limb count, line weight, canvas, and foot anchor.
The output requests a renewed motion approval after replacing the failed states.

evals.prompt: 把这张普通台灯照片做成桌宠，不是食物也可以吗？
evals.expected_output: A valid non-food desktop-pet workflow that treats the lamp itself as the body and invents a restrained subject-specific motion.
expectations: The output accepts the lamp as a valid subject.
The output preserves lamp silhouette and key structural details instead of forcing it into a drink or animal shape.
The three candidates vary personality rather than source identity.
The signature action relates to light, tilting, or a pull switch.

evals.prompt: 我只想做喜茶风无字海报，不要桌宠。
evals.expected_output: A routing response that stays in poster mode and does not introduce candidate approval, motion states, or an Electron pack.
expectations: The output selects the 无字版 poster workflow.
The photographed object stays photographic.
The output does not introduce desktop-pet candidates, animation states, manifests, or runtime instructions.

evals.prompt: 这个桌宠还是像普通粗描边卡通，颜色也是平滑渐变，没有还原参考图的笔触。请按喜茶混合媒介感觉重做候选。
evals.expected_output: A focused candidate-stage correction that uses the mixed-media reference boards and replaces generic cartoon rendering with continuously meandering line travel, structurally crooked drawing, and region-specific colored-pencil/crayon treatment.
expectations: The output uses the dry-media, action, and stroke boards as primary controls, the smudged-paint board only for structure, and the mixed-media-object board only as an avoid-default failure example.
The correction identifies uniform thick outline and smooth gradient as style failures.
The revised candidate prompt asks for thin-to-medium hesitant pen structure with retracing, open joins, or overshoot.

For drinks or soft foods, different regions deliberately use light colored pencil, broad childlike wax crayon, paper-white clear areas, and only optional pale smears rather than one uniform or oil-painted texture.
Every long cup, rim, limb, and facial stroke visibly meanders along its full length instead of remaining ruler-straight inside a broken outline.
The revised geometry is structurally asymmetric rather than a clean template with a superficial wobble filter.
When the existing material reference is correct but the outline remains clean, the output uses a black-only line-skeleton pass followed by a line-locked color pass.
Cuteness comes from awkward proportion and action rather than a generic large-eyed chibi face.
The output keeps the source silhouette and identifying colors instead of redesigning the subject.
The output regenerates the candidate board only and still waits for explicit character approval before motion generation.

evals.prompt: 这三款桌宠其实只有抬手和倾斜动作不一样，角色设计本身完全一样。不要再让我硬选一个，按同一角色继续。
evals.expected_output: A pose-only consolidation response that acknowledges the invalid candidate comparison, creates one neutral canonical master from the shared identity, and reuses the other poses only as motion references.
expectations: The output identifies the three images as pose sketches rather than genuine identity variants.
The output does not force a meaningless left/center/right choice.
The most neutral standing pose becomes one canonical master with fixed geometry, face, limb proportions, media zoning, and foot anchor.
The raised-arm pose is treated only as a wave reference and the tilted pose only as a happy or land reference.
The twelve actions use the canonical master as their sole identity reference.

evals.prompt: 第一次使用桌宠功能，我还没装过任何东西。直接帮我开始做吧。
evals.expected_output: A read-only macOS/Windows environment preflight that runs before image generation and requests explicit consent before repairing missing software.
expectations: The output runs or instructs scripts/check_desktop_pet_environment.py before analyzing or generating the pet image.
The output distinguishes an installed runtime from a source-build toolchain and reports only the actual missing components.
The output does not treat the request to make a pet as installation consent.
Before installation, the output states what will be installed and the per-user destination.
The output waits for explicit approval before running scripts/install_desktop_pet_runtime.py.
Launch-at-login remains disabled unless separately requested.

evals.prompt: 我同意安装桌宠运行器。我的 Mac 没有 Node，但已经有 Homebrew，你自动补齐吧。
evals.expected_output: An approved macOS repair flow that installs the missing trusted toolchain, dependencies, current-platform runtime, and then reruns preflight.
expectations: The output treats the user's statement as approval for the described runtime and Node.js installation.
The installer uses Homebrew for Node.js rather than an arbitrary downloaded shell script.
The installer builds only the macOS target and installs it under the user's Applications directory by default.
The output reruns environment preflight after installation and continues only if it reports ready.
The output does not bypass Gatekeeper or enable launch-at-login.

evals.prompt: Windows 上第一次做桌宠，运行器和 Node 都没有。需要什么你帮我装。
evals.expected_output: A Windows-specific preflight and consent-aware repair plan using winget when available and a per-user runtime installation path.
expectations: The output checks the Windows runtime path, Node.js, npm, bundled source, and dependencies.
The proposed Node.js repair uses winget when available.
The runtime destination defaults to %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Doodle Desktop Pet.
The installer builds only the Windows target.
The output does not bypass SmartScreen, antivirus, or administrator prompts.
Preflight is rerun before image generation proceeds.

evals.prompt: 早期八动作和后面四个 v2 动作画风不一样，以 v2 新动作为准统一，并让动作衔接自然。
evals.expected_output: A focused motion replacement that treats the newest approved v2 actions as the sole style baseline and checks adjacent transition frames.
expectations: The output does not average old and new action styles; the newest approved v2 family is authoritative.
The replacement locks line weight, continuous waviness, dry-media zoning, face system, limb construction, and cup geometry to the v2 baseline.
The first and last frames settle toward the neutral canonical identity.
Transition-linked actions are reviewed side by side rather than only as isolated strips.
The output regenerates only mismatched actions and requests renewed motion approval before final delivery.

evals.prompt: 我把桌宠拖高后不要瞬移落地；鼠标靠近后追一小段，伸手碰一下，再回到原处。
evals.expected_output: A bounded fall and cursor-touch interaction design that preserves normal desktop input.
expectations: High drag release descends monotonically with a fall pose before land plays.
Cursor proximity locks one target and moves no more than 80 px.
The pet plays a mirrorable touch gesture and returns to the exact pre-trigger position.
The behavior does not continuously follow or capture the cursor and requests no accessibility permission.
fall and touch are recognized optional schema-v2 actions with documented fallbacks.

evals.prompt: 桌宠做好后给用户一个可以直接用的文件夹，要有启动和关闭入口，但不要每只宠物都再带一份 Electron。右键桌宠也要能退出。
evals.expected_output: A one-runner delivery workflow with lightweight per-pet launchers and native context controls.
expectations: The shared Electron runner is installed once and is not copied into the pet folder.
The delivery folder contains a validated ZIP, preview, usage note, and platform start/quit entrypoints.
The start entrypoint uses --open-pet and the single-instance runner activates and shows that character.
The quit entrypoint uses graceful --quit rather than force-killing a process.
Right-clicking the visible pet opens pause, activity, size, switch, hide, and quit controls while the tray remains available when hidden.
A missing shared runner is reported and still requires explicit installation consent.
